hook.text: Your cache holds 10,000 items but an 11th arrives. Which item gets kicked out to make room?

buildup.text: Eviction policies decide which items to remove: LRU (Least Recently Used), LFU (Least Frequently Used), or FIFO.

discovery.text: LRU evicts the item that hasn't been accessed longest. It works well for most workloads.

twist.text: LRU fails for scan-heavy workloads: one full table scan evicts all your hot data and pollutes the cache.

climax.text: No eviction policy is universal. The right one depends on your data's access patterns.

punchline.text: Eviction decides what stays in cache and what leaves.

quiz.question: What does LRU eviction do?
options: Removes the item that hasn't been accessed for the longest time
Removes the most recently used item
